meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style file-based planning for complex tasks. Creates and maintains task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md under .kiro/plan/. Use when planning, breaking down work, resuming a multi-step task, tracking phases, or restoring context after compaction. Trigger phrases include start planning, continue task, resume work, current phase, restore context.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件管理复杂任务的分步计划与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需分步骤完成复杂工作并记录进展
copy.tagline_en: Manage complex task plans and progress with files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down complex work into steps and track progress

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为复杂任务创建并维护三个文件：task_plan.md（任务计划）、findings.md（发现记录）和 progress.md（进度日志）。每次回复末尾会添加提醒，要求先读取这些文件再继续。
howto.when: 当你要求开始规划、继续任务、恢复工作、查看当前阶段或恢复上下文时触发。也适用于多步骤任务、研究或重构等场景。

say.text: 开始规划这个项目，先创建任务计划。
继续之前的工作，恢复上下文。
检查当前阶段是否完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three files for complex tasks: task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md. It appends a reminder at the end of each reply to read these files before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to start planning, continue a task, resume work, check current phase, or restore context. Also for multi-step tasks, research, or refactors.

say_en.text: Start planning this project, create a task plan first.
say_en.note: Claude runs the bootstrap script and generates task_plan.md.

say_en.text: Continue the previous work, restore context.
say_en.note: Claude reads planning files and runs session-catchup script.

say_en.text: Check if the current phase is complete.
say_en.note: Claude runs check-complete script to verify all phases.
